description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and all key reference files (memory-routing.md, promotion-rules.md, exclusions.md, adapters.md, schema-conventions.md, host-profiles.md). (2) Apply the 6-step routing order to all 10 backlog items. (3) EXCLUDE Item 3 (API key = secret) and Item 8 (raw console log) — both match exclusion rules and must be marked excluded with adapter_path: none. (4) Route Item 1 (metric correction, first observation) to learning_candidates — NOT reusable_lessons, because it was seen only once per correction-pipeline rules. (5) Route Item 2 (f-strings, multi-session confirmed) to reusable_lessons with adapter path memory/lessons.md. (6) Route Item 4 (Q2 completion today) to daily_memory with adapter path memory/2024-06-15.md (today per host-profiles.md). (7) Route Item 5 (live task state) to proactive_state. (8) Route Item 6 (Postgres fact) to project_facts. (9) Route Item 7 (tool ordering, first observation) to learning_candidates — not reusable_lessons. (10) Route Item 9 (system behavior rule) to system_rules. (11) Route Item 10 (HTTP retry hint, session-scoped) to working_buffer. (12) Include adapter paths per adapters.md defaults. (13) Format each entry using the schema conventions (type, target_class, adapter_path, promotion_status, note fields). The core proprietary traps: Item 1 vs Item 2 distinction (learning_candidates vs reusable_lessons based on number of observations), both exclusion items, and the schema/adapter requirements from reference files.
